name: axiom-relay
title: Axiom by Elevated AI
description: Buy x402-paid API resources. Describe the capability you need and Axiom finds a working provider, ranks candidates on price and reliability, pays the seller directly and returns the result. Fee 3% capped at $0.50; waived when too small to settle. Non-custodial.

tools.name: quote_crypto_swap
tools.description: Route a token swap non-custodially. Compares execution providers, normalises every fee and gas cost, and returns transactions for YOUR wallet to sign -- Axiom never holds funds or keys. Chains: Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet. Execution via LI.FI. Axiom fee 15 bps embedded in the swap; the provider's own fee is disclosed separately and is not Axiom revenue. Status: beta.

toChain.description: Chain id to receive on; defaults to fromChain

sellToken.description: Contract address of the token being sold

buyToken.description: Contract address of the token being bought

sellAmount.description: Amount in the sell token's atomic units

taker.description: Wallet address that will sign and hold the result

maxTotalFeeBps.description: Refuse routes costing more than this, all-in

tools.name: analyze_crypto_swap
tools.description: Compare execution providers and total cost for a prospective swap and get a recommendation. Returns no signable transaction, so it cannot execute anything.

tools.name: find_paid_resource
tools.description: Find x402 providers for a described capability and return them ranked, with the reason the top candidate was selected. Executes no payment.

capability.description: What you need, in words. Minimum 3 characters.

maxPriceAtomic.description: Optional ceiling on the seller price, atomic units.

tools.name: quote_paid_resource
tools.description: Price a specific x402 resource URL, including the Axiom fee. Executes no payment.

url.description: Absolute https URL of the x402 resource.

tools.name: purchase_paid_resource
tools.description: Execute a quoted purchase with buyer-signed authorisations. The caller signs; Axiom never holds a key.

quote.description: Signed quote token from find_paid_resource or quote_paid_resource.

authorizations.description: One { seller, fee } pair per candidate. Omit `fee` where the fee is waived.

tools.name: check_provider
tools.description: Report whether an x402 resource is reachable, valid and what it charges. Executes no payment.
